verdict.rationale: Runloop's core product is Devboxes, described as secure sandboxed execution environments and isolated Linux sandboxes for AI coding agents. The docs cover executing code and commands inside them, egress network policies, and gateways that keep API keys and MCP credentials away from agent code, so untrusted code stays off the developer's own infrastructure. Missing for 10: details on the isolation mechanism (e.g., VM or container boundary), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the security claims.
